text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S got injured, so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: What are you gonna do if that injury gets worse?
What will you do if your injury gets worse?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Then—light training.
I want to minimize—any disruptions to the schedule."
choice_data_list: Please rest up until you're completely healed.
As long as it's within reason...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: But if we do that, the plan will—
choice_data_list: I'll make sure we make up for lost time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Persuade her that readjusting the training menu
will allow her to catch up once she's fully healed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Understood.
In that case—I have no objections.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: For a while, I'll... focus on treatment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Then—a light run, to start.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Any more of this is dangerous.
We're stopping training."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed her injury had worsened.
Symboli Kris S was put on rest for a while...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Let us proceed—as planned.
I shall keep any disruption to the schedule—to a minimum."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S overcame her injury at this pace,
and her return to training went remarkably smoothly.
